# Rosemary West

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-thirties (thirty-five during her engagement to John Meredith)  <sub>[v5 c2 P64](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0064), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Mary / Four Winds region  <sub>[v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c21 P28](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Music teacher  <sub>[v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c4 P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosemary West is a tall, remarkably handsome woman with a fresh, youthful appearance and a sweet, placid demeanor. She has large, clear, companionable blue eyes, a high white forehead, and soft pink cheeks. Her most striking feature is her thick, golden hair, the color of new molasses taffy, which she wears coiled smoothly over her head.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c4 P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050), [v5 c13 P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Rosemary is a sweet, gentle, and deeply sympathetic woman who possesses a girlhood-like freshness and a delighted, youthful perspective on life. She has an instinctive understanding of children and a rare knack for making them feel comforted and heard. Though inherently loving and kind, she holds a strong sense of honor and loyalty to her vows, which一度 caused her to sacrifice her own romance. She possesses an appreciative humor and a quiet dignity, maintaining her gracious composure even when facing difficult personal choices.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009), [v5 c20 P15](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0015), [v5 c20 P19](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0019), [v5 c20 P28](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0028), [v5 c21 P22](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0022), [v5 c21 P31](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0031)_

## History

Rosemary West grew up in a secluded, vine-hung gray house on a hill near Glen St. Mary with her sister Ellen. At seventeen, her first love, Martin Crawford, was lost at sea, an event that deeply shadowed her early youth. Following the death of their mother, a distraught Ellen coerced Rosemary into swearing a solemn oath on the Bible that neither sister would ever marry or abandon the other. Rosemary lived quietly at the hill farm for years, teaching music to local children, including the Blythe twins. She met the widowed Presbyterian minister, John Knox Meredith, at the hidden spring in Rainbow Valley, where they formed a deep mutual attraction. When John eventually proposed to her, Rosemary—bound by her vow to Ellen—refused him by letter, leaving both heartbroken. Shortly afterwards, Norman Douglas renewed his courtship of Ellen, who agreed to marry him provided she released Rosemary from her oath. Rosemary then accepted John Meredith's proposal after his daughter, Una, visited her to ask if she would marry her father. Their double wedding with Ellen and Norman was planned for September, bringing joy and a long-awaited motherly presence to the motherless children of the manse.

## Quotes

> It isn't because of you poor little souls that I cannot be your father's wife. I never thought of such a thing. You are not bad—I never supposed you were.  <sub>[v5 c34 P16](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0016)</sub>
